A browser-based Python course that runs entirely in VS Code. No install, no setup.

VS Code for Education offers an intro-to-Python course that runs in the browser with a full editor experience. For learners who get stuck on environment setup before writing a single line of code, this removes that barrier entirely.

If you teach Python or mentor beginners, bookmark this.

Check it out here: http://amplt.de/OffbeatHilariousPage
